description:
• Possuir Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem;

  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;

Promover a assistência de enfermagem as gestantes e/ou parturientes que buscam atendimento, proporcionando um atendimento seguro. Participar, analisar e avaliar os processos de enfermagem e as interfaces com a equipe visando a qualidade e de acordo com o código de Ética da Enfermagem;

Coordenar e controlar diariamente a programação normal em curso e as emergências;

Manter inter-relação com a equipe de trabalho da Internação obstétrica, para em tempo hábil recepcionar a parturiente na sala de pré-parto;

Participar na realização do exame obstétrico da paciente em trabalho de parto, realizando sua internação e encaminhamentos sempre que possível, acolhendo de forma humanizada as pacientes encaminhadas e/ou que procuram nosso Serviço;

Orientar o paciente e o acompanhante sobre o funcionamento do setor e as funções dos profissionais presentes;

Orientar a paciente durante o trabalho de parto, de acordo com seu estado atual, preparando-a sempre que possível para o parto, explicando sobre posições, deambulação, banhos e massagens durante o trabalho de parto;

Orientar sobre os exames obstétricos realizados e seus resultados;

Garantir a privacidade da paciente, mantendo-a sempre coberta ao exame obstétrico;

Orientar, incentivar e acompanhar o trabalho das Doulas junto às gestantes e puérperas no incentivo ao aleitamento materno na 1ª hora de vida;

Realizar controle do trabalho de parto, com criteriosa observação de cada parturiente, intervindo sempre que necessário, independente de horários pré-estabelecidos em planos de assistência ao trabalho de parto;

Fazer controle de batimento cardíaco fetal, tendo o cuidado de ouvir antes, durante e após a contração;

Realizar contato com outros serviços para realização dos exames externos;

Prestar cuidados de enfermagem à paciente em observação obstétrica, como ausculta fetal, cardiotocografias, dinâmica uterina, exames complementares;

Comunicar ao médico de plantão qualquer intercorrência;

Anotar todas as observações percebidas no prontuário;

Manter-se o máximo possível ao lado da parturiente no período final de dilatação, dando-lhe apoio, suporte emocional e orientações precisas sobre o que está ocorrendo;

Planejar e controlar o encaminhamento da cliente à sala de parto, evitando que este procedimento seja realizado de maneira emergencial, causando desconforto e dor à cliente;

Fazer escovação das mãos, degermação e antissepsia de pele e, utilizar técnica asséptica adequadamente, prevenindo infecções;

Realizar o parto, permitindo nesse momento, plena participação da mãe nesse processo, oferecendo apoio emocional, segurança, carinho e respeito às suas limitações pessoais, impostas pelas circunstâncias em que se encontra;

Fazer revisão criteriosa de canal de parto;

Realizar a episiorrafia e suturas de lacerações e roturas, se houver e observar sangramento e contratilidade uterina;

Checar em prontuário e junto aos colaboradores se a prescrição médica e a assistência de enfermagem estão sendo realizadas corretamente;

Orientar e supervisionar Equipe de Técnicos e Auxiliares de Enfermagem;

Manter o pré-parto, salas de parto e berçário em condições de uso normal e emergencial;

Providenciar reposição de material e medicamento de uso e cuidar do abastecimento para o serviço;

Verificar funcionamento dos equipamentos e providenciar as manutenções preventivas e corretivas sempre que necessário;

Promover reciclagem e atualização de rotinas e procedimentos de enfermagem nos cuidados à paciente;

Observar e cumprir normas e rotinas preconizadas pelos órgãos controladores dos serviços de saúde;

Preencher prontuários conforme rotina, observar prescrição dos cuidados de Enfermagem para o pós-parto na Unidade de Puerpério;

Participar das ações de parceria entre a unidade de saúde e as instituições de ensino, considerando a indissociabilidade da relação entre ensino e serviço, apoiando o desenvolvimento de campos de estágio, pesquisa e/ou residência no seu setor de trabalho;

Apoiar e propiciar condições para aquisição de conhecimentos no campo profissional de estagiários e/ou residentes nas atividades assistenciais sob sua responsabilidade, quando solicitado e conforme avaliação junto ao gestor imediato;  

 Observar o cumprimento dos aspectos éticos envolvidos na assistência ao usuário, quando os espaços de atendimento e a realização de procedimentos envolva a participação de estagiários, pesquisadores e/ou residentes;

Participar das oportunidades de formação e desenvolvimento ofertadas como contrapartida pelas instituições de ensino;

Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;

Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD.

Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

title: Recepção para unidade de saúde
description:
Sobre o cargo

Estamos buscando um(a) recepcionista excepcional para fazer parte do nosso time em uma clínica médica. O candidato ideal não é apenas alguém que sabe como receber bem as pessoas, mas também alguém com habilidades afiadas em vendas presenciais, supervisão de equipe e gerenciamento de crises. Este papel é crucial para criar uma experiência cativante para nossos pacientes, ao mesmo tempo em que assegura a excelência operacional da clínica.

Sobre a Habitat

A Habitat Consultórios é uma plataforma inovadora que conecta profissionais de saúde a espaços de atendimento, otimizando a utilização de consultórios e melhorando a experiência de profissionais e pacientes. A Habitat não é apenas um espaço de saúde; é uma experiência. Somos uma empresa dedicada a oferecer serviços de saúde de alta qualidade, onde a excelência no atendimento e a inovação se encontram. Aqui, cada detalhe é pensado para melhorar a vida das pessoas. Nossa cultura prioriza o relacionamento humano, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a adaptação às novidades do mercado. Se você é uma pessoa que busca impactar positivamente a vida dos outros e deseja fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica e empenhada, você pertence à Habitat!

Cultura da Habitat

Valorizamos a proatividade, a excelência no atendimento e a capacidade de adaptar-se e crescer em um ambiente dinâmico. Nossos colaboradores são incentivados a desenvolver suas habilidades e a buscar novas oportunidades de crescimento dentro da organização.

Atividades

· Atendimento ao Cliente: Receber pacientes e profissionais de saúde com um sorriso no rosto, garantindo que se sintam bem-vindos e confortáveis.

· Vendas Presenciais: Identificar oportunidades de upsell e cross-sell de nossos serviços e produtos, mantendo um foco firme em atingir metas de vendas.

Por isso, buscamos pessoas cada vez mais diversas e inovadoras para fazer parte desse propósito!Se você também sonha alto (ao infinito e além!), tem paixão no que faz, tem garra (cai mas levanta!), trabalha com transparência, e quer um ambiente de trabalho onde você tenha a oportunidade de evoluir constantemente, a Jovens Gênios é o seu lugar!

Aqui, temos as melhores pessoas e todas se unem pelo mesmo propósito: transformar a educação mundial através da tecnologia e democratização de acesso.


Como será o seu dia a dia: 

- Ambiente super divertido e descontraído; 
- Aprendizado contínuo;
- Troca de ideias e de referências com pessoas de diferentes áreas;

title: Consultor funcional sap fi  financial | especialista | projeto s/4hana | remoto
description:
Estamos em busca de um Consultor Especialista em Funcional SAP FI – Financial, para atuação em um projeto de implementação SAP S/4HANA em uma empresa de grande porte e líder no setor de lubrificantes, localizada no Rio de Janeiro na Barra da Tijuca.

Responsabilidades:
1.    Análise e Levantamento de Requisitos:
•    Preparar, conduzir e documentar os Workshops A e B, de acordo com a metodologia definida no projeto
•    Conduzir reuniões com stakeholders para entender as necessidades e requisitos do negócio
•    Aportar conhecimento das melhores práticas do S/4HANA 
•    Documentar os processos futuro (to-be) baseado nas melhores práticas, identificando áreas de melhoria, com foco em finanças e tesouraria
•    Identificar os requisitos de negócio aderentes às melhores práticas ou eventuais Gaps a serem aprovados e desenvolvidos, sempre alavancando o uso do processo standard, Aplicativos FIORI e prezando pelo clean core
•    Desafiar as necessidades de customizações através de exemplos de outros clientes que operam de forma mais standard.
2.    Configuração do S/4HANA:
•    Configurar os módulos FI-GL / FI-AA para atender às necessidades específicas de contabilidade e ativo fixo do cliente, conforme definição na fase de desenho
•    Aportar conhecimento das melhores práticas do setor e do S/4HANA na configuração do sistema
•    Garantir a integração nativa com outros módulos SAP, através da interação e alinhamento da solução com os consultores dos demais módulos

3.    Customizações / Desenvolvimento de Soluções:
•    Desenvolver soluções eficientes para a os processos de Contabilidade e Ativo Fixo, considerando as melhores práticas do setor e do S/4HANA, prezando pelo clean core 
•    Elaborar especificações funcionais e cenários de teste para as Customizações identificadas, para otimizar os processos de finanças e tesouraria e garantir as integrações necessárias com sistemas externos
•    Suportar a equipe de desenvolvimento nas customizações e realizar os testes unitários destas customizações

4.    Testes e Validação:
•    Conduzir testes unitários e integrados para garantir que as configurações e customizações atendam aos requisitos do negócio.
•    Coordenar e participar de testes de aceitação do usuário (UAT) com os usuários finais e atuar na resolução dos defeitos

5.    Treinamento e Suporte:
•    Suportar e desenvolver materiais de treinamento, conduzir sessões de treinamento para os super usuários (train the trainer).
•    Fornecer suporte contínuo durante a fase de implementação e nos 3 meses de suporte pós go live.
6.    Gestão de Mudanças:
•    Colaborar com a equipe de gestão de mudanças para garantir uma transição suave para o novo sistema, identificando os possíveis impactos organizacionais.
•    Comunicar mudanças e atualizações de forma eficaz para todas as partes interessadas.


Requisitos:

O profissional será responsável por conduzir as frentes de finanças e ativos fixos, atuando de ponta a ponta no projeto — desde o levantamento de requisitos junto às áreas de negócio, até a configuração do sistema, execução de testes integrados e suporte em fases críticas, como go-live e pós go-live.

Habilidades e Qualificações:

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de implementação do S4HANA nos módulos FI-GL e FI-AA
  • Experiência em ECC e AMS.
  • Conhecimento profundo dos processos de negócios relacionados a finanças para empresas do setor de lubrificantes.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa em um ambiente híbrido, com excelente comunicação e habilidades interpessoais.
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas de forma proativa e eficiente.
  • Experiência em conduzir treinamentos e fornecer suporte a usuários finais.

Benefícios

- Cartão Flash no valor de R$ 500,00/Mês;
- Acesso ao Wellhub;
- Convênio Zenklub - Psicólogo / Nutricionista / Coaching/ Terapia;
- 22 dias de suspensão de serviços remunerados sem que isso afete a sua contraprestação mensal depois de 1 ano de empresas;

title: Técnico de segurança do trabalho - rede de hospitais - diversos bairros
description:
Somos a Rede Hospital Casa um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDARestá entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como TÉCNICO DE SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO que seja organizado, prestativo e que tenha uma comunicação assertiva em seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:

·         Aplicar os conhecimentos técnicos de Segurança do Trabalho de modo a reduzir, neutralizar ou eliminar os riscos à segurança do trabalhador;

·         Orientar o sistema de segurança do trabalho, investigando riscos e causas de acidentes, fazendo as necessárias recomendações para evitar acidentes semelhantes, analisando esquemas de prevenção, observando dispositivos legais e institucionais que objetivem a eliminação, controle ou redução permanente dos riscos de acidentes do trabalho e a melhoria das condições do ambiente, para preservar a integridade física e mental dos trabalhadores;

·         Inspecionar locais, instalações e equipamentos da empresa e determinar fatores de riscos de acidentes;

·         Realizar auditorias internas e treinamentos de Segurança do Trabalho em todos os Setores da unidade Hospitalar, de forma rotineira, identificando condições insalubres e perigosas, tomando todas as providências necessárias para eliminar as situações de riscos, bem como orientar e conscientizar os colaboradores quanto a atitudes de segurança no trabalho;

·         Elaborar e implementar política de saúde, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente (SSMA);

·         Exigir o cumprimento das condições básicas de Segurança do Trabalho para empresas prestadoras de serviço e contratadas para execução de serviços nas dependências do estabelecimento hospitalar;

·         Acompanhar de forma permanente as atividades realizadas pela CIPA, estudando suas observações e propostas, visando a adoção das soluções corretivas e preventivas de acidentes do trabalho e meio ambiente dela valendo-se como agente multiplicador;

·         Controlar, distribuir e inspecionar os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI);

·         Elaborar documentos de segurança do trabalho como Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais, dentre outros;

(ENGLISH SPEAKERS)


Location: The Netherlands (on-site), 1-2 - year contract with potential of permanent employment, NOT project/freelance


Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in substations (up to 500kV) and energy transmission projects across global markets.


We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, contribute to energy transition solutions, and bring excellence to our electromechanical and protection systems.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)
  • Prepare and analyze layout drawings, grounding mesh, cable routing, and auxiliary systems (AC/DC)
  • Design single-line, three-line, and interconnection diagrams
  • Ensure compliance with international standards (IEC, ANSI, IEEE, ABNT)
  • Perform technical documentation review and approval (FATs, BOMs, technical specs)
  • Interface with clients, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams
  • Contribute to engineering reports including ROI, CAPEX, and technical feasibility


What We’re Looking For:


  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in high-voltage substation design (preferred: 230kV to 500kV)
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD (See Electrical, Eplan P8 or similar is a plus)
  • Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems
  • Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
  • Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
  • English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus


Bonus:

  • Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
  • Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
  • Understanding of ESG practices in engineering


Why Join Us:

  • Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
  • Get involved in international projects with real impact
  • Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
  • Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture



Who is Xelvin?


Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.


Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!


As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.

Onboarding & benefits:

title: Estágio em Engenharia (Gestão de Energia)
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Principais atividades:

  • Apoiar a gestão administrativa dos projetos da área;
  • Elaborar relatórios para acompanhamento de indicadores;
  • Realizar a gestão de pedidos de faturas de energia;
  • Monitorar sistemas e apoiar nas rotinas operacionais;
  • Interagir com diferentes unidades e interfaces, mantendo boa comunicação e organização.


Requisitos:

  • Estar cursando a partir do 6º período dos cursos de Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Eletrônica, Engenharia Mecatrônica ou Engenharia de Telecomunicações;
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e com boa comunicação;
  • Disponibilidade para modelo híbrido (3 dias presenciais por semana);
  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro/RJ.


Benefícios

  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Kit office.


A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +760 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.


Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Project Manager for Brazil (Utility)
description:
Hoymiles Power Electronics Inc., -– short Hoymiles (688032.SH)-is a globally leading inverter manufacturer with offices and services around the globe. The headquarters is based in Hangzhou China and the R&D department and manufacturing facilities are based there. 6. Self-driven working mind set, willing to dig in and find out problems, report with clear logic, always providing multi proposals to choose from.

title: Senior System Engineer - Computing Technology
description:
Senior Systems Engineer, Core 42, Abu Dhabi - UAE


Please note this position requires relocation to Abu Dhabi, UAE.


About Us


Core42, a leader in AI-powered cloud and digital infrastructure, is driving transformative technology solutions globally. Leveraging advanced resources and partnerships, Core42 empowers clients to harness sovereign AI infrastructure, especially in sectors with stringent regulatory needs. With a mission to redefine digital transformation, we combine sovereign capabilities with scalable, high-performance compute infrastructure, positioning itself at the forefront of AI innovation in the Middle East and beyond.


The opportunity


The Senior Systems Engineer – Computing Technology engages in the design, leads implementation, and provides Level 3 expert support for large-scale private cloud computing infrastructure, with a specific emphasis on computing technologies including hardware layer, operating system, hypervisor, and orchestration services.


Your Key Responsibilities


  • Co-design, implement, and manage hybrid virtualization and containerized platforms based on OpenStack, VMware VCF and/or Red Hat OpenShift ensuring platform stability, performance and compliance with industry standards and best practices.
  • Collaborate with architecture and engineering teams on technology stack component evaluation and selection ensuring solutions are designed following best practices and optimized from both functional and non-functional perspectives.
  • Conduct regular capacity planning exercises to anticipate and accommodate the growing demands on the virtualized environment, ensuring it meets current and future requirements.
  • Develop and implement plans to enhance the reliability of the computing infrastructure, addressing potential points of failure and ensuring high availability of services.
  • Explore, analyze, and implement performance optimization strategies for the cloud computing environment, ensuring optimal resource utilization and responsiveness.
  • Collaborate with relevant teams to conduct regular performance assessments and implement improvements based on findings.
  • Prepare and participate in complex changes to production environments supporting operational teams.
  • Develop auto-test and automation solutions for cloud platform using tools like Jenkins and Selenium along with other configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, and GitLab CI/CD.
  • Provide L3 expert support including on-call shifts with focus on immediate incident management and resolutions, such as outages, breaches, and system failures.
  • Write and maintain relevant documentation ensuring completeness and quality.
  • Prepare and provide trainings for operational teams in the related technical domains.
  • Collaborate with security management teams to ensure that systems are safe and secure against cybersecurity threats.
  • Work closely with process management and operational teams and contribute to process development standardizing collaboration framework and improving collaboration efficiency


What we're looking for


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Software Engineering, or other relevant technology field.
  • 7+ years of experience and deep expertise in designing, implementing, and managing private cloud stacks with the focus on compute and virtualization technologies.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with at least one of the following platforms/stacks: OpenStack, Apache CloudStack, VMware VCF and Red Hat OpenShift and related computing technologies such as x86 hardware, OS, KVM/ESXi and orchestration services.
  • Expert level in Linux and 5+ years of hands-on experience in Linux-based environments.
  • Profound understanding of hardware architecture and components (x86 and ARM, NUMA, types of memory and channels, types of NICs, etc.
  • Good understanding of network and storage types and architecture.
  • Good understanding of Cloud Native concepts and technologies.
  • Experience in managing large-scale public or private cloud environments and/or work in a cloud service provider environment is highly desirable.
  • Advanced level in programming and scripting using Python and/or Golang, bash.
  • Good knowledge in Data center network designs and related technologies (OSI model, TCP/IP stack, routing, VLAN/VxLAN, etc)
  • Understanding of storage types, architecture, and protocols such as object/block/file storages, NFS/SMB, iSCSI, FC, etc.
  • Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools like Zabbix or Nagios, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana).
  • Understanding of CI/CD principles, Infrastructure as Code (IaaC) approach and software defined infrastructure solutions.
  • Experience with database management and optimization for both SQL and NoSQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Cassandra is highly desirable.
  • Experience with ITSM tools such as Jira, Redmine, ServiceNow etc.
  • Relevant certifications in Linux, virtualization and cloud computing are a plus.
  • Knowledge and experience working with GPU-hardware and AI hardware accelerators is a plus.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and decision-making.


What working at Core42 offers


With a diverse team of 1,100+ employees from 68 nationalities, we foster an inclusive, innovative and collaborative environment. At Core42, we foster a culture grounded in trust, accountability and high performance. We are united by our values: Grit , where we overcome challenges with resilience and determination, Passion , which drives us to pursue excellence in everything we do, and Impact , as we aim to inspire progress and create meaningful change. Our team members thrive in an environment where each person’s contributions propel us forward, and together, we commit to achieving extraordinary results.


  • Competitive Salary: We offer an attractive salary package based on your skills and experience

  • Learning & Development: We offer access to top-tier learning platforms to help you grow in your career. Learn at your own pace with unlimited access to premium courses.

title: Digital Construction Coordinator
description:
Digital Construction Coordinator - UAE


Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.


This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia


Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises


In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.


ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.


Why Join Us?

As a Digital Construction Coordinator, you'll be responsible for managing information using BIM (Building Information Modelling) across a construction project. The role ensures stakeholders meet digital deliverables and information requirements, with a primary focus on BIM, though it may also involve broader digital techniques like scanning and drones.


Your Role:

  • Communicate and manage internal/external information requirements
  • Help develop and maintain BIM execution plans, responsibility matrices, and other key documents
  • Configure and support common data environments (CDE) and EDMS
  • Oversee 3D model coordination, clash detection, and issue reporting
  • Provide training and support on BIM tools and processes
  • Conduct QA/QC checks on models
  • Assist with resource estimation, tendering, and reporting
  • Support digital initiatives and improvements with the Head of Digital Construction


What We're looking For

  • Solid understanding of ISO 19650 and previous standards (e.g., PAS 1192)
  • Proficiency in BIM tools (e.g., Revit, Navisworks, Revizto)
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie)
  • Experience with CDE platforms (e.g., Aconex, BIM 360)
  • Skills in automation tools (Solibri, Dynamo, Python)
  • Experience with 4D/5D modeling and Power BI for data reporting
  • Strong communication and collaboration
  • Detail-oriented and analytical
  • Confident, resilient, and proactive
  • Passion for digital transformation in construction


What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization


Ready to elevate your career?

Apply now and be part of ALEC’s legacy of excellence. (attach your CV in English)

Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

title: Principal Pipeline Drafter 25002281
description:
Company Overview:

People power our future. That is why advancing a dynamic, inclusive environment, where everyone grows and thrives is critically important to us. Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing offshore platforms hundreds of miles from shore, and using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries. Here, what you do matters.


Job Overview:

The Principal Pipeline Drafter directly impacts the effectiveness of their team and related team. They exchange ideas and information relating to Pipeline Drafting effectively. The Principal Pipeline Drafter may work autonomously within established Pipeline Drafting procedures and practices. They act as a lead, coordinating the work of others. The Principal Pipeline Drafter proposes improvements to processes and methods within the Pipeline Drafting discipline.


Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with project teams to develop and refine detailed piping system designs, ensuring compliance with applicable codes, standards, and project specifications
  • Prepare accurate and comprehensive 2D and 3D pipeline drawings, layouts, and schematics using computer-aided design and drafting (CADD) software
  • Review and interpret project drawings, specifications, and engineering deliverables to accurately capture project requirements and constraints
  • Coordinate with other disciplines such as process, mechanical, and structural engineering to integrate pipeline designs seamlessly into the overall project layout
  • Provide technical support and guidance to junior draftsmen to ensure high-quality and timely deliverables
  • Conduct interdisciplinary clash detection reviews to identify and mitigate clashes or conflicts among various piping systems, equipment, and structures
  • Assist in the preparation of material take-offs, bills of quantity (BOQ), and requisitions to support procurement activities
  • Continuously improve pipeline design processes and standards, staying updated with the latest industry practices, advancements, and technological tools
  • Collaboratively work with project managers and engineers to effectively communicate design progress, and challenges, and ensure timely completion of deliverables
  • Participate in design reviews, constructability assessments, and HAZOP studies to provide valuable insights and contributions to the project team
  • Implement Prefabrication, Erection methods, and DC reports information into shop drawing
  • Implement design change in the shop drawing based on approved SQ, TQ, SI and ARN
  • Identify non-original scope using Change Management System


Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • High School diploma or higher with a focus in Mechanical Engineering, Pipeline Engineering, or related field
  • Minimum of 8 years of Pipeline Drafter experience in the Oil & Gas Construction Industry, with a focus on pipelines, and demonstrates a strong understanding of pipeline design principles and practices.
  • Proficiency in using CAD software, such as AutoCAD, Navisworks, PDS, PDMS, Bently Microstation, or similar tools, for creating pipeline/piping designs and drawings
  • Familiarity with different pipeline materials, fittings, and supports, and their respective installation methods and constraints
  • Strong understanding of pipeline/piping design concepts, including isometric, orthographic, and schematic drawings
  • Deep knowledge of industry-specific codes and standards like ASME B31.3, ASME B31.4, API 570, API 1104 and ASME Sections VIII & IX
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on accuracy and quality in drawing creation and review processes
  • Strong understanding of interdisciplinary coordination and interface management among various engineering disciplines
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders
  • Flexible and adaptable mindset to thrive in a dynamic and challenging work environment

Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

A área de Planejamento em Prevenção de Perdas atua como o cérebro estratégico da operação, conectando análises financeiras, orçamentárias e contratuais à execução prática das ações de mitigação de perdas em toda a cadeia operacional. Seu papel é garantir o uso eficiente dos recursos destinados à Prevenção de Perdas, por meio do controle rigoroso de orçamento (budget), acompanhamento de CAPEX/OPEX, e gestão de contratos com fornecedores de tecnologia, segurança, auditoria e serviços correlatos.


Além disso, a área é responsável pelo provisionamento e reversão contábil de perdas, garantindo aderência às políticas internas e compliance com normas financeiras. A interlocução com áreas como Controladoria, Compras, Jurídico, Financeiro e Operações é constante, exigindo perfil analítico, organizado e com forte senso de responsabilidade sobre prazos e entregas.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:


  • Garantir que os investimentos e despesas da área estejam aderentes ao budget anual, monitorando variações, evitando estouros e propondo realocações estratégicas quando necessário.
  • Assegurar o correto acompanhamento de vigência contratual, SLA, reajustes, aditivos e pagamentos de notas fiscais, evitando atrasos, glosas ou passivos.
  • Atuar como elo entre Prevenção de Perdas e áreas como Financeiro, Controladoria e Jurídico, traduzindo necessidades operacionais em ações financeiras/compliance e vice-versa.
  • Realizar estimativas confiáveis de perdas e investimentos, com metodologia clara para provisionamento e reversões, fundamentando tomadas de decisão do comitê executivo.
  • Equilibrar investimentos de capital (ex: instalação de novas tecnologias) e despesas operacionais (ex: manutenção de sistemas de CFTV) de forma eficiente e transparente.
  • Buscar constantemente formas de reduzir retrabalho, integrar sistemas (ERP, BI, etc.) e melhorar a previsibilidade e rastreabilidade de informações e custos.
  • Contribuir para a construção de um plano de perdas sustentável, que una a inteligência financeira ao propósito de proteger o negócio de riscos e desperdícios.

Deputy Operations Manager

Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Must be able to pass security background investigations, but do not have to be US citizens.


Essential Job Functions

  • The Deputy is responsible for assisting the OFC manager on the day-to-day operations of the Off-site Facilitation Center (CASV). He/She must ensure that the OFC operations comply with all requirements of the contract and satisfies all expectations of the supported US Post.

  • Main responsibilities: Assist the Operations Manager in the following activities:
  • Ensure that the OFC operates effectively, providing quality service to all Visa applicants while maintaining compliance with the provisions of the contract, CSRA policies and procedures and governing laws of host country.
  • Implement the visa application processes to insure all applications are processed accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Provide accurate reports according to predetermined schedules. These include, but not limited to: Monthly templates/reports for various Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Monthly status reports, and other ad-hoc reports as may be required by the client, the Post and/or CSRA.
  • Recruit, train, and manage staff to support OFC operations. Address performance issues and develop/implement corrective actions.
  • Manage all facility-related matters to include physical and personnel security.
  • Manage labor, facility and expense budgets as provided by and under the direction of the CSRA Operations Manager, and budget estimates, as requested.
  • Manage the Information Technology (IT) operations and ensure that all equipment are operated and maintained properly.
  • The Deputy Operations Manager will represent the Operations Manager when he/she is on vacation and or leave.
  • Day-to-day duties include, but not limited to: he/she attends meetings with the Post and CSRA Task Order Manager to discuss service levels.
  • He/she manages the OFC budget, coordinates with and manages suppliers and/or subcontractors who are supplying services to the OFC, i.e. courier service, bank institutions, building maintenance crew, etc.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office Suite.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Supervisory & People Management (Team Management) / Facility Management / Vendor Management experience.
  • Must be fluent in English (speak, read, write) and Portuguese.
  • Must be able to pass security background investigations, but do not have to be US citizens.


Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong human relations skills to select, develop, mentor, discipline and reward employees.
  • Challenges others to develop as leaders while serving as a role model and mentor.
  • Strong interpersonal and presentation skills for interacting with team members and clients.
  • Strong organization and time management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a team environment
  • Is results oriented and customer focused.
  • Identifies opportunities for improvement and makes constructive suggestions for change.

Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Pré-requisitos:

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações em Gestão de Projetos (PMP, CAPM, CSM, PSM, SAFe, etc.) , Melhoria de Processos (Lean, Six Sigma, BPMN) ou Design de Serviços/Jornadas .
  • Experiência em projetos de transformação digital, automação de processos ou implantação de tecnologias para CX .

description:
QA/QC Engineer | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

In the role of a QA/QC Engineer, you'll support our project execution teams in delivering high-quality construction projects on schedule. You will be responsible for coordinating and performing QA/QC activities, including inspections, tests, and closeout requirements, ensuring all work complies with project specifications, drawings, and contract requirements.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities—we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Review and understand all project contract documents and specifications.
  • Conduct daily site inspections to identify and report defects and ensure subcontractor compliance with Inspection Test Plans (ITPs).
  • Prepare and manage inspection schedules aligned with the project timeline.
  • Perform work and material inspections, ensuring rejected materials are quarantined and removed.
  • Collaborate with execution teams to implement corrective actions and conduct root cause analysis for non-conformances.
  • Monitor Fire & Life Safety installations and ensure compliance with authority regulations.
  • Track project deliverables, inspection approvals, and quality KPIs using analytical tools.
  • Support snagging, project closeout, and defect liability period (DLP) activities.
  • Maintain daily site diaries and QA/QC documentation.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a QC Engineer in construction environments.
  • Strong knowledge of construction processes and quality control standards.
  • Experience with project closeout procedures and defect management.
  • Familiarity with MEP works is advantageous.
  • Analytical skills and experience with data management and basic data analytics.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills.
  • Positive attitude, passion, and commitment to quality work.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.

Apply today and be part of something excellent!

title: Project Engineer

Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.

title: Digital Construction Coordinator
description:
Digital Construction Coordinator - UAE

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Digital Construction Coordinator, you'll be responsible for managing information using BIM (Building Information Modelling) across a construction project. The role ensures stakeholders meet digital deliverables and information requirements, with a primary focus on BIM, though it may also involve broader digital techniques like scanning and drones.

Your Role:

  • Communicate and manage internal/external information requirements

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments

Ready to elevate your career?

Apply now and be part of ALEC’s legacy of excellence. (attach your CV in English)

title: Digital Construction Engineer
description:
Digital Construction Engineer - UAE

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Digital Construction Engineer, you will be responsible for driving and supporting the implementation of information management processes using Building Information Modelling (BIM) across the lifecycle of a construction project. You will serve as a key liaison between the project management team and external stakeholders (consultants, subcontractors, and clients), ensuring digital deliverables and information workflows align with project and client requirements. While your core focus will be on BIM and data coordination, your scope may also include supporting digital construction technologies such as 3D scanning, drones, field data capture, and robotics. You will play an active role in embedding digital best practices and contributing to the project's digital strategy from planning through handover.

Your Role:

  • Support development and communication of BIM and information requirements.
  • Assist in preparing and maintaining project documentation (BEP, MIDP, EIR, LAP, etc.).
  • Configure and maintain Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows in EDMS platforms.
  • Set up BIM workflows and coordinate 3D models, identifying and resolving clashes.
  • Provide BIM training and guidance to internal departments.
  • Conduct QA/QC checks on models for internal teams and subcontractors.
  • Support digital tendering efforts and contribute to project-level digital reporting.
  • Represent BIM in project coordination and progress meetings.
  • Collaborate on the development of standards, templates, and digital procedures.

What We're looking For

  • Strong understanding of ISO 19650 and BS 1192.
  • Proficiency in BIM authoring tools (e.g., Revit, Tekla, Archicad).
  • Experience in BIM coordination tools (e.g., Navisworks, Revizto).
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie) and model checking (e.g., Solibri).
  • Knowledge of CDE platforms (Aconex, BIM 360) and scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera).
  • Visual programming (Dynamo) and Power BI experience preferred.
  • Understanding of 4D/5D BIM workflows and outputs.
  • Strong communicator with collaborative mindset.
  • Detail-oriented, analytical, and proactive.
  • Resilient under pressure with strong time management.
  • Passionate about digital innovation in construction.

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization

Ready to elevate your surveying career?

title: Offshore Cargo Supervisor
description:
We are looking for an Offshore Cargo Supervisor for one of our clients in O&G, in an offshore position (14 X 14).

This is a TEMPORARY POSITION, for a 6 ~ 9 months (renewable) project.

Offshore Cargo Supervisor: What will your responsibilities and missions be?

Responsible for supervising, monitoring, and participating in all marine-related activities, such as offloading operations, transshipment with support vessels, cargo handling and cleaning, ballasting operations, tank washing (COW), equipment maintenance, diving operations, and pull-in/pull-out operations. All these activities must be carried out with a focus on safety and in compliance with internal and external procedures and regulations, always in support of the Marine Superintendent and under his authority. He is also jointly responsible for ensuring the readiness and availability of the offshore facility's rescue equipment.

What Profile and Skills are Required for this Cargo Supervisor Position?

  • Nationality: Brazilian Only
  • Local of work: Offshore – onboard FPSOs (boarding points: Jacarepaguá, Macaé, Farol de São Tomé, Cabo Frio, Maricá)
  • English: Intermediate to Advanced

Graduation/Certificate:

  • Minimum: Marine or technical background — e.g., Marinheiro de Convés, CB, Mestre de Cabotagem or equivalent maritime certification.
  • Required Certifications (valid at embark): CBSP, CACI, CESS, MCIA, NR-33 (Confined Space), NR-35 (Work at Heights), H2S Awareness, Benzeno Awareness, GASD, ECOW (modules 1 to 4)
  • Search parameters: COW AND Ballast Operations AND Diving Support AND Lifesaving Equipment AND Offshore Cargo Handling

Experience:

  • Proven experience in offshore cargo operations, marine logistics, ballast management, and tank cleaning procedures
  • Experience coordinating diving support and marine safety inspections
  • Availability for temporary offshore rotation (14x14)

Are you interested in this position? Send us your application!

EP2C Energy’s Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

By joining our team, you will be expected to follow HSE procedures and best practices while contributing to the continuous improvement of our processes.

Who Are We? – EP2C Energy

Founded in 2014, EP2C Energy is a fast-growing technical assistance company specializing in:

  • Energy (Renewable Energies, Oil & Gas, Nuclear)

With an international presence — including subsidiaries in Latin America, Africa, and Asia — we collaborate with major industry players and offer exciting career growth opportunities in France and worldwide.

At EP2C Energy , we value our employees’ expertise and are committed to their professional and personal development.

Joining EP2C Energy means becoming part of a dynamic team and an ambitious mission!

title: Section Manager
description:

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.

Why Join Us?

As a Section Manager, you’ll play a vital role in the successful execution of MEP works across complex data center projects. You’ll lead field productivity, manage change effectively, and ensure technical excellence in every phase.

At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.

About Your Team

You’ll report directly to the Construction Manager, with indirect reporting to the Project Manager, and will lead a team of Site Engineers and Foremen. The section management team ensures quality, safety, productivity, and coordination across MEP disciplines, collaborating closely with planning, QA/QC, procurement, and subcontractors to ensure seamless execution across project zones and disciplines.

Your Role

As a Section Manager, you will:

  • Issue daily/weekly installation plans and report progress.
  • Enforce method statements, risk assessments, and DSTI schedules.
  • Track material deliveries in coordination with Project Engineers.
  • Manage change and drawing/spec distribution.
  • Monitor tools, consumables, KPIs, and labour productivity.
  • Ensure HSE and QA/QC compliance at all times.
  • Work week: Monday to Saturday (standard for project-based roles in the region)

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years’ experience in MEP construction or infrastructure
  • Strong knowledge of installation sequencing, QA/QC, and HSE
  • Site leadership and technical documentation experience
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills

What We Offer

  • Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.
  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.
  • A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

title: Bim Modeler - MEP
description:
MEP BIM Modeler - UAE

Are you a hands-on professional with a passion for precision and performance? Join us in delivering high-quality MEP systems for landmark projects in the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEMCO will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.

Why Join Us?

As a BIM Modeler, you’ll play a pivotal role in transforming design information into precise 3D models and construction documents. You’ll support our field operations with shop drawings, schedules, and coordinated data, driving project accuracy and collaboration forward.

At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.

Your Role

  • Review tender and IFC information (2D drawings, BIM models, asset data) per ISO19650 standards
  • Create and maintain Revit-based BIM models, including GA plans, sections, diagrams, and schedules
  • Perform clash detection and support clash avoidance coordination
  • Maintain clean, healthy BIM models following industry best practices
  • Update and revise models/documents based on RFIs, design changes, and site instructions
  • Identify inconsistencies in contract documents and flag them appropriately
  • Assist with as-built documentation and handover preparation
  • Work collaboratively in shared environments (CDE), supporting both internal and external teams
  • Follow project standards, templates, protocols, and document control procedures
  • Provide accurate technical responses to site queries and requests

What We’re Looking For

  • Technical Diploma in Architecture, Civil or Mechanical Engineering
  • Minimum 3 years of BIM experience on construction projects
  • Proficient in Revit and AutoCAD
  • Familiarity with CDE platforms and coordination tools (Revizto, Navisworks)
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office and Adobe Acrobat
  • Understanding of BIM principles and workflows
  • Strong written and spoken English skills

What We Offer

  • Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.
  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.
  • A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Civil BIM Modeler , you will be responsible for developing and managing BIM models for our construction projects in compliance with ISO19650 and company standards. You will lead the BIM modeling efforts, coordinate with project teams, ensure model accuracy, and support BIM QA/QC processes to deliver quality outputs that meet project requirements.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Review Tender & IFC BIM models, 2D drawings, and asset data issued by consultants in line with ISO19650 standards.
  • Lead BIM modeling for design documents; guide and mentor a team of modelers.
  • Prepare BIM models and generate general arrangement plans, diagrams, sections, elevations, and schedules using Revit.
  • Maintain and optimize BIM models following best industry practices to ensure healthy, coordinated models.
  • Coordinate with BIM and design teams to support modeling from 2D CAD plans and construction documents.
  • Conduct clash detection and support clash avoidance measures.
  • Assist internal and external stakeholders with the development and updating of construction documents.
  • Maintain and apply company/project BIM standards, templates, and content.
  • Update models and drawings based on RFI responses, engineering instructions, and design changes.
  • Identify discrepancies in contract documents and report them promptly.
  • Ensure all work complies with project information standards, BIM Execution Plans, and ALEC BIM implementation standards.
  • Support as-built/redline and handover processes by updating models and extracting accurate drawings.
  • Provide timely and accurate information to site teams and project managers.
  • Follow a Monday to Saturday work schedule consistent with project-based industry norms.

What We’re Looking For

  • Diploma in Architecture or Civil Engineering (3 years).
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience as a BIM Modeler in GCC countries.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Revit and AutoCAD .
  • Advanced knowledge of BIM fundamentals, principles, and workflows.
  • Experience working in a collaborative shared environment.
  • Good written and spoken English.
  • Proficiency with Navisworks and/or Revizto .
  • Advanced skills in MS Office and Adobe Acrobat.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Vaga para Representante | PJ/ Parceria/ Canal de Vendas

Sobre a ZEISS:

Fundada como uma fábrica para mecânica de precisão e óptica na cidade de Jena, Alemanha, em 1846, a Carl Zeiss é hoje um líder mundial nas indústrias óptica e optoeletrônica. Temos escritórios em mais de 30 países e somos representados em mais de 100 países, com centros de produção na Europa, América do Norte, América Central e na Ásia.

Nossa tarefa mais importante é levar os usuários da tecnologia ZEISS a áreas que permaneceram escondidas no passado. Nós somos líderes de mercado na maioria dos campos onde atuamos. Oferecemos um espectro extraordinário de soluções inteligentes e produtos nas áreas de Tecnologia Médica, Tecnologia em Metrologia Industrial e Tecnologia em Microscopia.

Sobre a nossa Divisão Médica:

Oferecemos soluções completas para diagnósticos e tratamentos oftalmológicos, além da avançada tecnologia de radioterapia intraoperatória e soluções de visualização inovadoras para neurocirurgia, odontologia, entre outros. Nosso portfólio possui promissoras tecnologias do futuro que garante aos seus parceiros e clientes confiança e excelência.

Sobre a nossa vaga de Representante Comercial | PJ/Parceria/Canal de Vendas | Divisão de Odontologia (atuação em Rio de Janeiro e Região)

Estamos em busca de Representantes Comerciais apaixonados por inovação e excelência no atendimento ao cliente para se juntarem à nossa equipe na divisão de Odontologia.

Como representante da marca ZEISS, você será responsável por:

- Prospecção Ativa: Identificar e engajar novos clientes, expandindo nossa presença no mercado odontológico.

- Demonstração de Produtos: Apresentar as características e benefícios das nossas Lupas de Magnificação e Microscópios Cirúrgicos.

- Relacionamento com o Cliente: Realizar visitas de pós-venda para garantir a satisfação e fidelização, além de identificar novas oportunidades de negócio.

- Educação Continuada: Participar ativamente de cursos, congressos e eventos, mantendo-se atualizado sobre as tendências do setor.

- Gestão de Vendas: Utilizar o CRM para gerenciar o funil de vendas, apresentar previsões e fechar negócios de forma eficaz.

Requisitos:

- Experiência mínima de 8 anos em vendas no setor odontológico.

- Histórico comprovado de sucesso em vendas e superação de metas.

- Conhecimento profundo do mercado e produtos odontológicos.

- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e relacionamento interpessoal.

- Disponibilidade para viagens e participação em eventos.

- Desejável conhecimento em CRM SAP.

- Inglês em nível intermediário ou avançado será um diferencial.

Benefícios:

- Comissão competitiva por venda, oferecendo um potencial ilimitado de ganhos.

ATUAÇÃO COMO PARCEIRO/ REPRESENTANTE/ CANAL DE VENDAS (PJ)

Se você está pronto para fazer parte de uma equipe que está na vanguarda da inovação em odontologia, aplique agora mesmo através do LinkedIn. A equipe da Carl Zeiss do Brasil está ansiosa para conhecer os próximos líderes de vendas que se juntarão a nós nessa jornada.

title: Principal Pipeline Drafter 25002281
description:
Company Overview:

People power our future. That is why advancing a dynamic, inclusive environment, where everyone grows and thrives is critically important to us. Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing offshore platforms hundreds of miles from shore, and using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries. Here, what you do matters.

Job Overview:

The Principal Pipeline Drafter directly impacts the effectiveness of their team and related team. They exchange ideas and information relating to Pipeline Drafting effectively. The Principal Pipeline Drafter may work autonomously within established Pipeline Drafting procedures and practices. They act as a lead, coordinating the work of others. The Principal Pipeline Drafter proposes improvements to processes and methods within the Pipeline Drafting discipline.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with project teams to develop and refine detailed piping system designs, ensuring compliance with applicable codes, standards, and project specifications
  • Prepare accurate and comprehensive 2D and 3D pipeline drawings, layouts, and schematics using computer-aided design and drafting (CADD) software
  • Review and interpret project drawings, specifications, and engineering deliverables to accurately capture project requirements and constraints
  • Coordinate with other disciplines such as process, mechanical, and structural engineering to integrate pipeline designs seamlessly into the overall project layout
  • Provide technical support and guidance to junior draftsmen to ensure high-quality and timely deliverables
  • Conduct interdisciplinary clash detection reviews to identify and mitigate clashes or conflicts among various piping systems, equipment, and structures
  • Assist in the preparation of material take-offs, bills of quantity (BOQ), and requisitions to support procurement activities
  • Continuously improve pipeline design processes and standards, staying updated with the latest industry practices, advancements, and technological tools
  • Collaboratively work with project managers and engineers to effectively communicate design progress, and challenges, and ensure timely completion of deliverables
  • Participate in design reviews, constructability assessments, and HAZOP studies to provide valuable insights and contributions to the project team
  • Implement Prefabrication, Erection methods, and DC reports information into shop drawing
  • Implement design change in the shop drawing based on approved SQ, TQ, SI and ARN
  • Identify non-original scope using Change Management System

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • High School diploma or higher with a focus in Mechanical Engineering, Pipeline Engineering, or related field
  • Minimum of 8 years of Pipeline Drafter experience in the Oil & Gas Construction Industry, with a focus on pipelines, and demonstrates a strong understanding of pipeline design principles and practices.
  • Proficiency in using CAD software, such as AutoCAD, Navisworks, PDS, PDMS, Bently Microstation, or similar tools, for creating pipeline/piping designs and drawings
  • Familiarity with different pipeline materials, fittings, and supports, and their respective installation methods and constraints
  • Strong understanding of pipeline/piping design concepts, including isometric, orthographic, and schematic drawings
  • Deep knowledge of industry-specific codes and standards like ASME B31.3, ASME B31.4, API 570, API 1104 and ASME Sections VIII & IX
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on accuracy and quality in drawing creation and review processes
  • Strong understanding of interdisciplinary coordination and interface management among various engineering disciplines
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders
  • Flexible and adaptable mindset to thrive in a dynamic and challenging work environment
